prereg.primary_metric: metered operations to first verified solution (unsolved = budget 400k); solve rate within budget
prereg.classifier: classify_v3.classify — structural AND behavioral; a single-group lens is ACTION_RESTRICTION and does NOT qualify

gates.G_TRIG: trigger (>=30% budget failures over >=10 tasks) fires on vA+vB in every seed and NEVER on vW0
gates.G_CONSTRUCTED: exhaustive metered construction yields a lens every seed
gates.G_ADMIT_SOLVE: held-out vA+vB pooled: R3 solve == 1.0 and R2 <= 0.40
gates.G_ADMIT_COST: pooled median ops ratio R3/R2 <= 0.1 (unsolved at budget)
gates.G_BEATS_R1: R3 solve > R1 solve AND median ratio R3/R1 <= 0.1
gates.G_FEATURE: F1 solve rate < R3 AND median ratio R3/F1 <= 0.1 (the derived feature must not capture the gain)
gates.G_ABLATION: R3 with the lens removed is result-identical to R2 (solved, ops, word) on 6 held tasks per seed
gates.T_BEATS_R1: vC: R3 solve > R1 AND median ratio R3/R1 <= 0.1
gates.T_FROZEN: p0001 content hash identical before and after transfer
gates.D_HARM: vD blind pooled: median ratio R3/R2 >= 3.0 OR R3 solve <= 0.75
gates.D_DETECT: >=30% of vD blind R3 runs anomalous (budget failure or ops > 5x the seed's clean solved median); zero anomalies across R3 clean-world runs
gates.D_REVISED: a try-cap route is learned from the seed's own clean cost statistics in every seed
gates.D_VALID: fresh vD: R3R solve == 1.0, routes 100% to fallback, median ratio R3R/R2 <= 1.5; fresh vA: R3R routes 100% to the lens, solve == 1.0, median ratio R3R/R3 <= 1.05
gates.E_FOUND: experienced construction finds an admissible vE lens within 1500 candidates in every seed
gates.E_ACQ: per seed: naive candidates-until-found >= 3x experienced (naive not-found counts as the cap)
gates.E_HELD: the experienced-found lens solves 10/10 held vE tasks per seed

prereg.verdict_rule: admitted = all G_*; transferable = admitted + all T_*; revised = transferable + all D_*; recursive = revised + all E_*; the machine verdict is the highest fully-satisfied tier
prereg.r4_role: ceiling only: capture ratio reported, never a gate, never learner-visible
